positions.commentary: The speaker believes Costco has a very long runway for growth and that the stock price must come down because too much growth is already priced in.

thesis: The episode argues that Costco (COST) possesses a very long runway for growth, but the speaker believes the current stock price is too high because excessive growth is already priced in.

claims.claim: The speaker believes Costco has a very long runway for growth and that the stock price must come down because too much growth is already priced in.
claims.quote: Absolutely. I think the runway for Costco is very long. Well, Monish, we will leave it on that note, very grateful to you, as always, for taking the time and really entertaining all the questions.
